work_package: WP-10 remediation — Production CAD Technology Evaluation Gate
rule: No library added merely because popular; no superior tech rejected merely for being external; licensing not used as technical rejection reason in this gate.

technologies.name: current_integrity
technologies.evidence: Existing WP-10 QC; measured on real tooth instances

technologies.name: trimesh
technologies.capability: mesh load, watertight/winding/volume inspection, collision support
technologies.evidence: Already production dependency; expanded into Production QC topology inspection
known_limitations: Does not provide robust appliance shell kernel

technologies.name: manifold3d
technologies.source: https://github.com/elalish/manifold ; transitive via trimesh[easy], now also explicit
technologies.evidence: Engineering boolean deterministic; real crown tooth import returns Error.NotManifold

technologies.name: meshlib
technologies.capability: engineering voxel offset/shell, self-intersection query, boolean
technologies.evidence: Real tooth Unsigned offset → watertight volume, deterministic hashes; source immutable
technologies.provenance_implications: engineering_offset operation + derived hash; truth REQUIRES_REVIEW

technologies.name: Open3D
technologies.version_evaluated: 0.20.0 (index only; not installed in product venv for this gate)
technologies.evidence: Overlaps trimesh+MeshLib for inspection/offset needs; REUSE_MATRIX planned but unused; high install cost without unique measured gain vs MeshLib for Production CAD
known_limitations: Heavy dependency; no unique Production CAD gap vs MeshLib in this evaluation

technologies.name: CGAL
technologies.evidence: High integration complexity (C++/bindings); Manifold+MeshLib cover evaluated boolean/offset needs
known_limitations: Heavy native stack; not required given measured MeshLib/Manifold results

technologies.name: libigl
technologies.evidence: Research-oriented; no Python-first product path needed after MeshLib/Manifold/trimesh coverage

statements: No library was added merely because it is popular.
No technically superior technology was rejected merely because it was external.
Every adopted technology has measured evidence.
Unsupported manufacturing operations (trimline, undercut, certification) remain NOT_AVAILABLE.
WP-11 and later work packages were NOT started.
